payload.blocks: Only the swap of the hand-written governance holder table in phase 5; phases 6 and 7 keep running.
payload.headline: Will you relay the generated governance holder-table preview to DOCOS for its yes or changes?

parts.cause: The supervisor cannot reach DOCOS: mailbox send is refused in its sandbox (event-seal lock on a read-only .git). DOCOS's earlier boundary answer came through the owner.

options.does: You send the preview file to DOCOS and answer here with its yes or its changes.
options.gain: Uses the route DOCOS already answered by; phase 5 closes after one unit.
options.harm: Needs a few minutes of your time.
options.label: Owner relays to DOCOS

options.does: Phase 5 closes without the swap; the generated holder block is dropped from this plan.
options.harm: The holder table stays a second hand-kept copy of the model.
options.label: Keep the table hand-written

parts.recommendation: Owner relays to DOCOS: the preview is ready and the swap is one unit once DOCOS answers.

scope.allows: The lead swaps only the governance holder table once DOCOS's answer is recorded.
scope.forbids: Any other change to governance.md or to DOCOS's side.

parts.what: Phase 5 landed (9486a7d80) every generated ownership view except the governance holder table. DOCOS asked to see the generated table before it replaces the hand-written one. The preview with a row-by-row diff is plans/261121-2109-component-authority/reports/holder-view-preview.md.
